    AI Overview
    NASA is the
    National Aeronautics and Space Administration, a U.S. government agency founded in 1958, responsible for civil space program, aeronautics research, and space exploration. It manages missions like the Artemis moon program, International Space Station operations, and satellite research. "Nasa" is also a Hebrew word meaning "to lift" or "carry". 
    NASA (Acronym Usage Examples): 
    • Space Exploration: "NASA satellites help people understand weather patterns on Earth".
    • Scientific Research: "Astronauts in orbit conduct scientific research".
    • Aeronautics: "NASA also helps develop and test new aircraft".
    • International Partnerships: "NASA maintains programmatic partnerships with agencies such as ESA, JAXA, CSA". 
    Common Synonyms & Related Terms for the Agency: 
    • National Aeronautics and Space Administration (Full Title)
    • The Space Agency (Often used in media)
    • US Space Program (Contextual) 
    Hebrew Word "Nasa" Meaning & Context: 
    • Root Verb: Means "he lifted," "bore," "carried" (נשא).
    • Movement: Can also mean "he set out" or "he journeyed" (נסע).
    • Context: Used in contexts such as "I carried you on eagles' wings" in Exodus 19:14.
    • Debunking Myth: Contrary to some online rumors, the Hebrew word for "deceived" (from Genesis 3) is heiani, not NASA, as explained by content creators discussing Hebrew etymology. 
    For more information, visit the official NASA website.
